title: The curve setting of the eight assertions
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $C$ be a curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], that is, a separated scheme of finite type over $k$ with $\dim C\leq1$. Let $F\in\Ab(C_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] be a torsion abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf]. A pair $(C,F)$ of this form is a *curve coefficient pair*.

The generic imported dependencies did not identify these notions. Mathlib has no combined curve coefficient pair.
